eventTypes.missingBody: The database update for this feature has not been applied yet. Nothing is broken — every event uses your normal setup.
eventTypes.noTypes: Because you have no event types yet, every event uses your normal setup.
eventTypes.name: Name
eventTypes.matchKeeps: Anything you changed on a single event’s dashboard stays as it is, and this type’s prices do not change.
eventTypes.deleteBody: {n, plural, =0 {No upcoming event uses “{name}”.} one {Upcoming events using “{name}”: {count}. They go back to “Standard”.} other {Upcoming events using “{name}”: {count}. They go back to “Standard”.}} Anything you changed on a single event stays as it is.
eventTypes.phone.vanSetup: This vehicle’s usual setup — used at every event with no type.
eventTypes.phone.standardSetup: Your usual setup — used at every event with no type.
eventTypes.phone.cardSummary: {upcoming, plural, one {{upcomingCount} upcoming event} other {{upcomingCount} upcoming events}} · {changed, plural, =0 {nothing changed yet} one {changed: {changedCount} / {total}} other {changed: {changedCount} / {total}}}
eventTypes.phone.noMenuItems: No menu items yet — add them in Menu › Items.
eventTypes.newType.title: New event type
eventTypes.newType.help: Tap a name or type your own name. It starts as a copy of “Standard”, and changing “Standard” later does not change it. Then change anything.
eventTypes.select.label: Event type
eventTypes.errors.noVans: This food truck has no vehicles to change.
privateEvents.grid.linkRowLabel: Take orders through the private link and QR code
privateEvents.grid.columnTitle: The built-in “Private” type. It cannot be renamed, moved or deleted.
privateEvents.form.help: Shows on your schedule as “Private event” with only the date and times — never shows the address, the map or Village Foodie.
privateEvents.form.linkPromise: Guests order through a private link and QR code — you will get them after saving.
privateEvents.form.nameHelp: Guests see this at the top of the order page.
privateEvents.form.previewNote: How it shows on your schedule — no venue, town or postcode.
privateEvents.form.needsTimes: Add a start and end time — a private event taking orders by link needs them.
privateEvents.link.title: Private link and QR code
privateEvents.link.label: Private link
privateEvents.link.newLinkConfirm: Make a new link? The current link stops working at once, and any QR codes you have already printed will stop working too.
privateEvents.link.newLinkHelp: Use this if the link has gone somewhere it should not. The current link stops working at once, and printed QR codes will stop working too.
privateEvents.link.newLinkFailed: A new link could not be made.
privateEvents.link.offNotice: Ordering by private link is switched off for this event, so there is no link to share. The event still shows on your schedule as “Private event”.
privateEvents.cards.blurb: Order and pay on your phone. When it is ready, we will call out your name.
privateEvents.noSinglePost: Private events do not get their own post — they appear on your weekly poster as “Private event”.
privateEvents.confirmToPrivate: This hides the address and the event from the map. Guests will need the private link to order.
privateEvents.confirmFromPrivate: This makes the event public: its address and map pin will show, and the private link will stop working.
